bio.text: Pat Proctor, a Republican, is a candidate for Kansas Secretary of State in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He has represented District 41 (Leavenworth County) in the Kansas House of Representatives since 2021.

According to Ballotpedia, he served in the U.S. Army from 1989 to 2019, earned a B.S. in mechanical engineering from Purdue University in 1994 and a doctorate in history from Kansas State University in 2014.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as including work as an assistant professor at Benedictine College and Wichita State University.
